 and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  30/12/ ABA No. 801 of 2023  2025 Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

This Application has been filed for anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 24 of 2017, registered at Police Station Rajpur, District Dehradun under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 504 and Section 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. Heard Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, learned Brief Holder for the respondent.
3.

Mr. Lalit Sharma, Advocate, on instructions, has requested to permit the applicant Nazia Yusuf Izuddin to withdraw the present anticipatory bail application with a liberty to file an anticipatory bail application before the Sessions Court.
4. The said request has not been opposed by the respondent.

5. The present Anticipatory Bail Application (ABA No. 801 of 2023) is dismissed as withdrawn,
granting liberty to the applicant to file an anticipatory bail application before the Sessions Court, but in accordance with the law.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 30.12.2025 Shiv/ 2025:UHC:11643 ABA/801/2023 on 30 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79143866/
